ORANGEADE
AN ATTRACTIVE "test total drink" popular in the tropics is orangeade.

It is merely the juice squeezed from oranges and run through a strainer into a glass or jug. If the oranges are acid, sugar will correct the fault. Also, half a glass of orange juice mixed with any lively aerated water is a beverage that would appeal even to an old toper. If a glass of orange juice were drunk each morning before breakfast there would not be so many complaints in the spring-time about sluggish livers. Oranges are very cheap. Why not try orangeade?
